name: Dance
overview: Scripture presents dance as a form of joyful expression and worship, as seen when Miriam led the women in dance with timbrels after God's deliverance (Exodus 15:20) and Jephthah's daughter greeted him with dances (Judges 11:34). The Psalms encourage praising God through dance and music, highlighting its role in celebrating God's power and turning mourning into gladness (Psalms 30:11, 149:3, 150:1). While the Bible affirms dance as an act of praise, it does not endorse secular dance environments such as dance clubs, focusing instead on dance that honors the Lord and reflects heartfelt worship.
